types.name: marketoverview.v1.BpsRange
types.doc:
BpsRange bounds a signed change in basis points (bp). Both bounds are
 inclusive; an omitted bound leaves that side unbounded.

fields.name: min_bps
fields.doc:
Lowest matching change, inclusive, in basis points; may be negative.
 Example: -500 = -5%. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.name: max_bps
fields.doc:
Highest matching change, inclusive, in basis points; may be negative.
 Example: 1000 = +10%. Omit for no upper bound.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.CurrencyMetadata
types.doc:
CurrencyMetadata supplies stable defaults for display conversion. Clients may
 localize names, symbols, and number formatting for the user's locale.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Uppercase currency or stablecoin code, such as EUR or USDT.

fields.name: default_english_name
fields.doc: Default English display name.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc:
Representative local display symbol; multiple currencies may share a symbol.
 Uses the code when the selected local display data has no distinct visible symbol.

fields.name: fraction_digits
fields.doc:
Default display fraction digits, including zero for currencies such as JPY.
 This is a formatting default, not rate precision, token decimals, or cash rounding.
 Stablecoins use two display fraction digits.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode is a stable domain error code enum for Market Overview.
 It is used for consistent error surfaces across ConnectRPC and REST.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc: ErrorDetail carries a typed domain error code for machine-readable handling.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code for programmatic matching.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.FiatConversionRate
types.doc: FiatConversionRate states the fiat currency units equal to one US dollar.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Supported fiat currency code.

fields.name: units_per_usd_e8
fields.doc: Fiat currency units per 1 USD, scaled by 1e8. USD has the identity value 1e8.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.FiatConversionSnapshot
types.doc: FiatConversionSnapshot contains all supported fiat rates from one observation.

fields.name: rates
fields.doc: Complete fiat rates, including USD, ordered by code.

fields.name: source_ts_sec
fields.doc: Shared source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

fields.name: stale
fields.doc: True once the source observation is at least two hours old.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetCurrencyConversionConfigRequest
types.doc: GetCurrencyConversionConfigRequest has no parameters.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetCurrencyConversionConfigResponse
types.doc:
GetCurrencyConversionConfigResponse contains finite, cacheable display metadata.
 It remains available before any rates have been observed.

fields.name: fiat
fields.doc: Supported fiat currencies, including USD, ordered by code.

fields.name: stablecoins
fields.doc: Supported stablecoins (USDC and USDT), ordered by code.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetCurrencyConversionRatesRequest
types.doc: GetCurrencyConversionRatesRequest has no parameters.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetCurrencyConversionRatesResponse
types.doc:
GetCurrencyConversionRatesResponse groups rates by their USD conversion direction.
 Last-known observations remain available with staleness indicated. Before any
 observation is available, the request fails with unavailable (HTTP 503).

fields.name: fiat
fields.doc: Complete fiat snapshot; absent until a complete snapshot has been observed.

fields.name: stablecoins
fields.doc: Observed stablecoin rates ordered by code. Unobserved stablecoins are omitted.

fields.name: snapshot_ts_sec
fields.doc: Response construction time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetSpotVolumeHistoryRequest
types.doc: A finite spot-volume chart request; no pagination or arbitrary time range.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Pair IDs from GetSpotConfig; empty selects every configured pair separately.
 At most 2000 distinct positive IDs. Unknown IDs are rejected. If the full
 universe exceeds 2000 pairs, specify a filter; results are never truncated.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetSpotVolumeHistoryResponse
types.doc:
Aligned columnar trailing-24h USD series over the most recent 24 hours.
 The grid always contains 97 samples ending at the latest completed UTC
 quarter-hour. Index i maps to start_ts_sec + i * 900 seconds. Each sample
 covers [sample time - 24h, sample time); only the preceding 48 hours contribute.
 USD conversion uses historical quote/USD prices at each completed bucket
 boundary. When conversion is unavailable, USDT and USDC are valued at USD parity.
 If any contributing trade cannot be valued, or a USD amount overflows,
 the RPC fails as unavailable; partial or zero-filled valuations are not returned.
 Intervals without executed trades are zero. Results may be reused for 15 seconds.

fields.name: bucket
fields.doc: Sampling interval between points; currently always "15m".

fields.name: start_ts_sec
fields.doc: First sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: end_ts_sec
fields.doc: Last sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Number of aligned values in every pair array and the total array; always 97.

fields.name: pairs
fields.doc: Pairs ordered by ascending symbol_id; at most 2000, each included once.

fields.name: total_volume_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Sum across selected pairs, USD scaled by 1e6. Exactly points values,
 oldest first. REST renders decimal strings in totalVolumeUsd.
 Do not sum overlapping trailing-24h samples to obtain period traded volume.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.ListMarketOverviewRequest
types.doc:
ListMarketOverviewRequest lists market overview rows. The symbol_id
 filter and the range filters combine: a market is returned only when it
 matches every filter given. Filters apply before sorting and paging.
 A range whose minimum exceeds its maximum is refused as invalid, with a
 violation on the range field (last_price, change_24h or volume_24h); a
 negative price or volume bound is refused with a violation on the bound
 itself, such as last_price.max_ticks.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Filter by stable numeric pair IDs from GetSpotConfig. When empty, returns
 every configured market, including disabled ones. An ID that names no
 configured market is rejected as invalid. Markets whose delisting time has
 passed are never returned.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of markets to return. Defaults to 50 when omitted; maximum
 is 2000.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol IDs, the range filters, sort key, and sort direction:
 reuse it with the same filters. A cursor reused with other filters or
 another sort is refused as invalid; request the first page again.
 Sparkline options affect only response enrichment and may change between
 pages. Each page is cut from current values, so a market whose sort value
 or range membership changes between pages can appear twice or not at all
 across them. For a consistent list, request a single page with the
 maximum limit.

fields.name: order_by
fields.doc: Sort key. When unset/UNSPECIFIED, defaults to descending 24h USD volume.

fields.name: sort
fields.doc: Sort direction (DESC=newest/highest first).

fields.name: include_sparklines
fields.doc: When true, include sparklines in each MarketOverview.

fields.name: sparkline_intervals
fields.doc:
Which sparklines to include. If empty and include_sparklines is true,
 server defaults to 24h.

fields.name: last_price
fields.doc:
Only markets whose last_price_ticks is within this range. When a bound is
 set, a market with no trade yet never matches. Omit for no price filter.

fields.name: change_24h
fields.doc:
Only markets whose signed change_24h_bps is within this range; sorting by
 ORDER_BY_CHANGE_24H_BPS still uses the absolute change. When a bound is
 set, a market whose 24h change has no open (open_24h_ticks is 0) never
 matches. Omit for no change filter.

fields.name: volume_24h
fields.doc:
Only markets whose volume_24h_usd_scaled is within this range. When a
 bound is set, a market whose USD volume is omitted never matches. Omit
 for no volume filter.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Market overview rows for the requested page.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

values.name: ORDER_BY_VOLUME_24H_USD
values.doc: Sort by canonical USD 24h volume. Unvalued markets sort last in either direction.

values.name: ORDER_BY_LAST_PRICE
values.doc: Sort by last price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

values.name: ORDER_BY_DATE_ADDED
values.doc: Sort by listing time (new listings first).

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: last_price_ticks
fields.doc: Last traded price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: last_trade_ts_ns
fields.doc: Last trade timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

fields.name: change_24h_bps
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h change expressed in basis points (bp). Example: +123 = +1.23%.
 Measured from the 24h open to the last price, at minute granularity: the
 24h open is the price at the start of the minute that contains the time
 24h ago or, for a market that first traded later, its first trade. 0 while
 the 24h open is unavailable (open_24h_ticks is 0 then): the market has no
 trade yet (its last trade timestamp is 0 too), its first trade is a few
 seconds old, or its trade history is temporarily unavailable.

fields.name: high_24h_ticks
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h stats. The 24h window starts at the start of the minute that
 contains the time 24h ago and ends now; its prices, volumes and trade
 count cover the same window.
 Highest price in the 24h window, counting its open and every trade, in
 quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: low_24h_ticks
fields.doc:
Lowest price in the 24h window, counting its open and every trade, in
 quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: open_24h_ticks
fields.doc:
The 24h open that change_24h_bps is measured from, in quote units scaled
 by 1e9. 0 while the open is unavailable, including when history is
 temporarily unavailable: the market has no trade yet, its first trade is a
 few seconds old, or its trade history cannot be read for a while.

fields.name: trade_count_24h
fields.doc: Number of trades executed in the 24h window.

fields.name: vwap_24h_ticks
fields.doc:
24h volume-weighted average trade price in quote units scaled by 1e9,
 rounded down: the exact 24h quote notional divided by the 24h base volume.
 The notional is not rounded to the quote scale, so dividing the displayed
 volume_24h_quote_scaled by volume_24h_base_scaled can differ slightly;
 clients cannot reproduce this value from the displayed volumes. The base
 volume is exact when the base asset's market_data_volume_scale equals its
 quantity_scale in GetSpotConfig. Otherwise each second with trades rounds
 its base volume to the volume scale, by at most half of one volume unit,
 so the base volume can be off by that much per second with trades and the
 price error shrinks as the total base volume grows. Omitted when the
 window has no base volume or the 24h base volume is omitted.

fields.name: open_utc_day_ticks
fields.doc:
Price at the start of the current UTC day (00:00 UTC), in quote units
 scaled by 1e9: the last trade price before the day's first minute or, for
 a market that first traded later that day, its first trade. Change since
 the day open is last_price_ticks against this price. 0 while the open is
 unavailable, including when history is temporarily unavailable: the
 market has no trade yet, a new day's first price is still being recorded
 (a few seconds after 00:00 UTC), or its trade history cannot be read for a
 while.

fields.name: stats_1h
fields.doc:
Rolling 1h stats, over the same minute-granular window as the 24h stats.
 Absent while the window's open is unavailable, including when history is
 temporarily unavailable: the market has no trade yet, its first trade is
 a few seconds old, or the window's trade history cannot be read for a
 while. Later fields may add volumes per window.

fields.name: stats_4h
fields.doc: Rolling 4h stats. Absent under the same conditions as stats_1h.

fields.name: stats_7d
fields.doc: Rolling 7-day stats. Absent under the same conditions as stats_1h.

fields.name: volume_24h_base_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h base volume scaled by the base asset's
 market_data_volume_scale from GetSpotConfig. Omitted if the amount exceeds
 the signed 64-bit range.

fields.name: volume_24h_quote_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h quote volume scaled by the pair's quote_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig. Omitted if the amount exceeds the signed 64-bit range.

fields.name: volume_24h_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h USD volume, scaled by 1e6 (one unit is 0.000001 USD).
 Applies the current quote/USD conversion to the rolling quote volume.
 When conversion is unavailable, USDT and USDC are valued at USD parity.
 Omitted for other quote assets when a current conversion is unavailable.

fields.name: listed_ts_ns
fields.doc:
Listing timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch. 0 when the pair has no
 listing time.

fields.name: best_bid_ticks
fields.doc: Current best bid price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: best_bid_qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Best bid quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: best_ask_ticks
fields.doc: Current best ask price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: best_ask_qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Best ask quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: sparklines
fields.doc: Optional sparklines (requested explicitly).

fields.name: index_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Current multi-venue index price in quote units scaled by 1e9.
 Zero when no fresh, valid index price is available.

fields.name: price_band
fields.doc:
The pair's live price band, as GetPriceBand returns it, present only
 while a band was confirmed current within the last 5 seconds. Absent
 means no fresh band is known, not that the pair has no band. This is a
 convenience copy: the market overview stream sends a row again when its
 band changes, appears or lapses, not on each confirmation, so a copy whose
 valid_until_ts_ns has passed is unknown. Check order prices against
 GetPriceBand or the price band stream.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.MarketOverviewBatch
types.doc:
MarketOverviewBatch is a websocket payload carrying batched market overview
 updates. It is published to a single all-markets channel at a fixed cadence.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Market overviews included in this batch.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Batch publish timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.PriceTicksRange
types.doc:
PriceTicksRange bounds a price in quote units scaled by 1e9. Both bounds
 are inclusive; an omitted bound leaves that side unbounded.

fields.name: min_ticks
fields.doc:
Lowest matching price, inclusive, in quote units scaled by 1e9; at least
 0. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.name: max_ticks
fields.doc:
Highest matching price, inclusive, in quote units scaled by 1e9; at least
 0. Omit for no upper bound.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.RollingWindowStats
types.doc:
RollingWindowStats summarizes executed trade prices over one rolling window
 that ends now. Like the rolling 24h stats, a window has minute granularity:
 it starts at the start of the minute that contains the time one window
 length ago. All prices are in quote units scaled by 1e9 and come from
 executed trades, never from the index price.

fields.name: open_ticks
fields.doc:
Price at the start of the window: the last trade price before the
 window's first minute or, for a market that first traded later, its
 first trade.

fields.name: high_ticks
fields.doc: Highest price in the window, counting the open and every trade.

fields.name: low_ticks
fields.doc: Lowest price in the window, counting the open and every trade.

fields.name: change_bps
fields.doc:
Change from the open to the last price in basis points (bp), truncated
 toward zero. Example: +123 = +1.23%.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.Sparkline
types.doc: Sparkline contains newest-first close prices for one time range.

fields.name: interval
fields.doc: Time range and sampling resolution represented by these close prices.

fields.name: close_ticks
fields.doc: Newest-first close prices in quote units scaled by 1e9.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.SparklineInterval
types.doc:
SparklineInterval identifies the time range and sampling resolution for a
 sparkline.

values.name: SPARKLINE_1H
values.doc: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_24H
values.doc: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_1W
values.doc: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_1M
values.doc: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).

types.name: marketoverview.v1.SpotPairVolumeSeries
types.doc:
One pair appears exactly once, regardless of its base and quote assets.
 REST renders the scaled amounts as decimal strings in volumeUsd.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID; clients may group these series by base asset.

fields.name: volume_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Trailing-24h USD amounts scaled by 1e6, oldest first. Exactly points values,
 aligned with the shared response grid. Zero means no executed trades in
 the window. USD values round down once per contributing 15-minute bucket.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.StablecoinConversionRate
types.doc: StablecoinConversionRate states the observed USD value of one stablecoin unit.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Supported stablecoin code (USDC or USDT).

fields.name: usd_per_unit_e8
fields.doc: USD per 1 stablecoin unit, scaled by 1e8. This is an observed price, not a fixed peg.

fields.name: source_ts_sec
fields.doc: This stablecoin's source observation time in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

fields.name: stale
fields.doc: True once this stablecoin's source observation is at least five seconds old.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.UsdVolumeRange
types.doc:
UsdVolumeRange bounds a USD volume scaled by 1e6 (one unit is 0.000001
 USD). Both bounds are inclusive; an omitted bound leaves that side
 unbounded.

fields.name: min_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Lowest matching USD volume, inclusive, scaled by 1e6; at least 0. Omit
 for no lower bound.

fields.name: max_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Highest matching USD volume, inclusive, scaled by 1e6; at least 0. Omit
 for no upper bound.
